channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Trump's diesel agreement with Putin accused of contradicting Russia sanctions law
item.description: Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said in a searing statement that the U.S. easing sanctions on Moscow "plays into Russia's hands."

item.title: Nvidia GPUs are everywhere. Here are the ways companies are accessing them
item.description: One industry researcher identified over 300 neoclouds that can provide GPU capacity, up about 55% in less than a year.

item.title: The world needs Ukraine’s grain. Its farmers are running out of reasons to plant
item.description: Cash-strapped farmers have no incentive to sow for 2027 with exports remaining trapped, as analysts say commodity markets could "flip fast."

item.title: Buffett's 'trips down YouTube rabbit hole' revealed
item.description: Warren Buffett watches CNBC in the morning, but nearly every evening he "can't get enough" of watching YouTube clips while sitting on a recliner in front of an "enormous" television in his Omaha home, reports The Wall Street Journal.

item.title: Isaias brings flood, tornado threats, power outages across U.S. Southeast after Florida landfall
item.description: More than 430,000 people in Florida and nearly 297,000 in Alabama lost power as the storm hit shore, according to power outage tracking firm PowerOutage.us.

item.title: French yields are near levels not seen since 2002. Why that could give U.S. Treasurys a boost
item.description: French and other European bond yields are surging, which may prompt a flight to the U.S. Treasury market, investors and strategists told CNBC.

item.title: From BJ’s to Lululemon, retailers are trimming assortments to boost business
item.description: Retail brands are shrinking assortments to get back to healthy growth, while box stores are culling products to better curate offerings and stabilize business.

item.title: Hollywood takes on Zuckerberg, Musk and Altman amid widespread anxiety over AI
item.description: New films about Zuckerberg, Musk, Altman and AI arrive as public concern about the technology and its leaders rises.

item.title: Dow rises 400 points on Friday as Wall Street scores winning week: Live updates
item.description: The Nasdaq Composite rose on Friday following a losing session.

item.title: AI is changing how lawyers work — and putting the billable hour under pressure
item.description: AI adoption is forcing the legal profession to rethink the billable hour and how lawyers build expertise.

item.title: Living with Mom and trading on margin. The regular investor gets in on Wall Street's record stock borrowing binge
item.description: Margin debt has surged to record levels as investors like 29-year-old Hy Luu borrow more against their portfolios. Here’s how leverage can amplify stock losses.

item.title: Nobel winner Krugman says France may have become 'too big to save'
item.description: Economist Paul Krugman sounded the alarm on a looming "ugly crisis," while former ECB head Jean-Claude Trichet said French politicians must compromise.

item.title: Cramer’s week ahead: Earnings kick off as banks and chipmakers face big tests
item.description: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said next week’s earnings reports will give investors a clearer picture of corporate performance and the strength of the AI trade.

item.title: Trump says Norway has 'indelible stain' for not awarding him Nobel Peace Prize
item.description: Each year of his presidency, Trump has expressed disappointment that he failed to win the prize.

item.title: Memory stocks have hit a malaise. Jay Woods believes it's a buying opportunity
item.description: Today we focus on of the most exciting and profitable sectors of 2026: DRAM.

item.title: Americans' debt problems are flashing a warning not seen since the Great Recession
item.description: Researchers found that while wealth disparities narrowed somewhat, the ability to meet debt payments deteriorated significantly.

item.title: Trump Media advisor Katie Zacharia offered White House press secretary role
item.description: The White House has tapped Katie Zacharia to be its next press secretary, a White House official confirmed to CNBC.

item.title: Junk bonds are 'flashing yellow.' Watch these warning signs
item.description: Spreads have widened in the high-yield bond market, but that doesn't tell the whole story.

item.title: Two massive trades just happened in Micron and Nvidia. What they could mean for chips
item.description: Bears continued to build up positions against the semiconductor group on Friday.

item.title: Trump created a committee to dig into the Fed's Lisa Cook. What is it and what comes next?
item.description: Trump’s bid to fire the Fed's Lisa Cook follows a Supreme Court ruling and could affect Jerome Powell, central bank independence and interest rates.

item.title: What's behind the recovery rally in tech stocks — plus, Elon Musk's very good week
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: Amex announces 2 new Centurion Lounges near New York City and in London, plus updates to two locations. These credit cards can get you in
item.description: Amex is updating Centurion Lounges at four different airports and introducing two new lounges at Newark Liberty International Airport and London Heathrow Airport.

item.title: Hurricane Isaias disrupts U.S. oil production in Gulf of Mexico, threatens refineries
item.description: The hurricane could tighten a fuel market that is already facing big disruptions from the wars in Eastern Europe and the Middle East.

item.title: Verizon posts worst day since 2002 as SpaceX U.S. network plans whack cell provider stocks
item.description: SpaceX announced the spectrum deal Thursday, as the company aims to push deeper into the telecom market through its Starlink service.

item.title: Tesla drops 'Full Self-Driving' brand name in Europe after regulator pushback
item.description: German regulators called Tesla's "Full Self-Driving" brand name "somewhat misleading."

item.title: Delta Air Lines cuts 2026 forecast on fuel surge, but CEO says demand is still strong
item.description: Delta Air Lines reported third-quarter earnings and missed Wall Street estimates for the first time in two years.

item.title: Trump appoints committee to investigate statements by the Fed's Lisa Cook
item.description: Trump tried to fire Cook, a nominee of former President Joe Biden, but the Supreme Court blocked his first attempt.

item.title: ICE won't pause enforcement in NY after Bronx shooting, DHS' Mullin says
item.description: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul said she asked Homeland Security Secretary Mullin and President Donald Trump to immediately halt ICE operations in her state.

item.title: The used car market is stagnant. Here's how to profit anyway
item.description: Michael Khouw breaks down this short strangle options trade.

item.title: Treasury's Bessent hires Trump's controversial former Fed board pick, Judy Shelton, as advisor
item.description: Shelton's controversial economic ideas led the Senate to block her nomination to the Fed. Now she's going to be a counselor to the Treasury secretary.
